task_context.problem_statement:
Danny collects bottle caps and wrappers. He found 82 wrappers and 29 bottle caps at the park. Now he has 42 bottle caps and 61 wrappers in his collection.
How many bottle caps did danny have at first?
( 42.0 - 29.0 )
